causality: predictions and smoothing at timestep t use only current and past inputs
primary_label_rule: lowest-index active class; background when no class is active
active_set_top1_rule: top-1 is correct when the predicted class belongs to the active label set
aggregate_accuracy_rule: argmax prediction equals the deterministic primary label
clean_transition_rule: the primary label changes and both adjacent target rows contain exactly one active class
transition_window_rule: start at the changed label and stop before the next true transition or after 16 timesteps, whichever occurs first
transition_success_rule: the first top-1 prediction of the new primary label within the transition window sets the delay
miss_rule: if the new label is not predicted within the window, count one miss and assign delay 16
